purpose: Replace a description with one that fits more accurately.
keywords: Description A + というより + description B
It is cool rather than cold.
He is more like a friend than a teacher.
I felt relieved rather than surprised.
formation: Description A + というより + description B
restrictions: Often offers a refinement rather than an absolute denial of A.
mistake: Unlike よりも, this compares labels or descriptions, not simply quantities.
